title: Mixed Team World Cup 2026 squads: Japan bring world No 1 Matsushima as teams name line-ups
seo_title: Mixed Team World Cup 2026 squads: every team named so far
description: Mixed Team World Cup 2026 squads for Chengdu: Japan, China, France, Sweden and Australia have named their players, and Great Britain make their debut.
standfirst: Japan, China, France, Sweden and Australia have named their players for the event in Chengdu from 29 November to 6 December, where 20 teams will play and Great Britain make their first appearance.
body: Japan will take the world's top two men, Sora Matsushima and Tomokazu Harimoto, to the Mixed Team World Cup in Chengdu, along with Honoka Hashimoto, who won [WTT Contender Istanbul](/news/wtt-contender-istanbul-2026-finals-fang-bo-honoka-hashimoto-titles.html) on Sunday and is in the team for the first time.

The 20 teams had to give the ITTF their squads by 9 November for the tournament, which runs from 29 November to 6 December, and [Germany](/news/mixed-team-world-cup-2026-germany-squad-winter-franziska-ovtcharov.html) and [Taiwan](/news/mixed-team-world-cup-2026-lin-yun-ju-cheng-i-ching-withdraw-taiwan-six-players.html) have also named theirs. China, the champions in each of the first three editions, will defend the title with Wang Chuqin and Sun Yingsha, while Sweden are without Truls Moregard and Great Britain will play as one team for the first time.
## How the 2026 event works

The field has grown from 16 teams to 20, split into two groups of 10 that each play a single round robin, according to Table Tennis Australia. The bottom two in each group finish joint 17th and the rest go into play-offs for their final places.

Each tie is made up of up to five matches: mixed doubles, men's and women's singles and men's and women's doubles. As in previous editions, every match is played over three games, and the first team to win eight games takes the tie. The French federation said teams must now use three women and three men in a tie rather than two of each, in line with the format for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics, where mixed team is a medal event for the first time.
## Japan: Matsushima, Harimoto and a first call-up for Hashimoto

The Japan Table Tennis Association (JTTA) named its eight players on 15 October. The men are Sora Matsushima (world No 1), Tomokazu Harimoto (No 2), Shunsuke Togami (No 15) and Hiroto Shinozuka (No 20). The women are Miwa Harimoto (No 3), Hina Hayata (No 6), Satsuki Odo (No 10) and Honoka Hashimoto (No 14).

Seven of the eight played at last year's event, where Japan lost the final to China. Hashimoto, the defensive player who beat Joo Cheonhui in the Istanbul final, is the only newcomer. Mika Baba is the team's general manager, with Seiya Kishikawa coaching the men and Rui Nakazawa the women.
## China: Wang Chuqin and Sun Yingsha lead the holders

The Chinese Table Tennis Association named [Wang Chuqin, Lin Shidong, Huang Youzheng and Zhou Qihao in the men's team and Wang Manyu, Sun Yingsha, Kuai Man and Chen Yi in the women's](/news/mixed-team-world-cup-2026-china-squad-wang-chuqin-sun-yingsha-chen-yi-zhou-qihao.html). Wen Ruibo, Wang Yidi and Chen Xingtong were left out. China are playing at home and are chasing a fourth title in a row.
## France: both Lebrun brothers

France have picked [Félix and Alexis Lebrun, Simon Gauzy and Flavien Coton, with Jia Nan Yuan, Prithika Pavade, Charlotte Lutz and Nina Guo Zheng](/news/mixed-team-world-cup-2026-france-squad-lebrun-brothers-guo-zheng.html). Félix Lebrun is the world No 3 and Alexis is in the top 10, giving France two of the strongest men in the field.
## Sweden: no Moregard

Sweden have [left out Truls Moregard](/news/mixed-team-world-cup-2026-sweden-squad-moregard-wtt-finals.html), the world No 6, so that he can prepare for the WTT Finals in Hong Kong, which start two days after the final in Chengdu. Anton Källberg, Elias Ranefur, Kristian Karlsson and Mattias Karlsson make up the men's team, with Christina Källberg, Filippa Bergand, Nomin Baasan and Alma Rööse in the women's. Linda Bergström misses out because she is pregnant.
## Australia: seven players led by Yangzi Liu

Table Tennis Australia has selected seven players: Yangzi Liu, Constantina Psihogios and Jiamuwa Wu in the women's team, and Finn Luu, Nicholas Lum, Hwan Bae and Aditya Sareen in the men's. Liu, the world No 42, is Australia's highest-ranked player, with Luu at No 46 and Lum at No 54.

Rob Gomm, the federation's general manager of the Olympic programme, said: "With Mixed Teams now an Olympic medal event, this World Cup is an important part of our preparation and provides another opportunity to test ourselves against the world's best."
## Great Britain make their debut

Great Britain will play at the Mixed Team World Cup for the first time. The ITTF recognises Great Britain, rather than the four home nations, only in the mixed team rankings, so the best players from England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland can play together on the road to the Los Angeles Olympics. Gavin Evans, Table Tennis England's head of performance development, said in August that the team was looking forward to "playing the Mixed Team World Cup in Chengdu in December". The squad has not yet been announced.
## What's next

The remaining teams are expected to confirm their players before the draw for the groups. Eleven will update the squads on the [Mixed Team World Cup 2026 event page](/events/mixed-team-world-cup-2026.html) as they are named, with the draw, schedule and live scores once play starts on 29 November.
